summary: Example rulebook: ansible.eda.webhook source on 0.0.0.0:5000 with insert_hosts_to_meta from payload.limit, and two throttled rules dispatching run_job_template when template_type is job and run_workflow_template when it is workflow, using names and organization from the payload.
questions: Show a rulebook that runs AAP job templates from Terraform events
How do I route Terraform events to job or workflow templates?
How do I use payload.limit as hosts in a rulebook?
